whenToUse: Mobile sheets shown briefly, such as share or options.
Closing must be easy with one hand.
whenNotToUse: Sheets with work in progress (confirm before closing).
The sheet holds a long vertically scrolling list (put the gesture on the handle only).

alternatives.name: Bottom Sheet
alternatives.reason: The structure and height of the sheet itself.

alternatives.name: Modal Dialog
alternatives.reason: On desktop, or when confirmation is needed.

accessibility: The close button and Esc also close it, so dragging isn't the only way.
When it closes, focus returns to the button that opened the sheet.
The drag area is limited to the handle so scrolling inside the sheet isn't blocked.
The spring-back animation turns off with reduced motion.
